Enlarge the sample by a whole factor.

Nearest or bilinear interpolation on ArrayFire; height and width are multiplied by the scale factor, the channels stay. Interpolation codes: 0=nearest, 1=bilinear.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Upsampling](../categories/upsampling.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | upsample, resize, interpolate |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Image feature map [H, W, C] per sample. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Upsampled feature map [H\*scale, W\*scale, C]. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Upsampling | Scale Factor | `scale_factor` | Integer | `2` | `1-1048576` | The run | Positive spatial scale. Required. |
| Upsampling | Interpolation Mode | `mode` | Choice | `0` | `0`, `1` | The run | Interpolation: 0=nearest, 1=bilinear. Required. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled as an ArrayFire upsampling layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
